description: This file defines a SocketConnection class for managing WebSocket-like socket communication, including message handling, data parsing, and version comparison functions.

classes.name: SocketConnection
classes.description: A class for managing socket communication, handling data reception, message dispatching, and socket lifecycle.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message object over the socket, serialized as JSON.

methods.name: _onData
methods.description: Handles incoming data buffers, parses messages separated by newline characters, and dispatches complete messages.

methods.name: _dispatchMessage
methods.description: Parses a message string and invokes the onmessage callback if available.
